notes.title: The Big Update & Rework 🛠️
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894220/6c38e8c407c31d6e56fe0b59ddb0fe43c28b6478.png

We’re excited to bring you a brand-new update to Tiny Connections—our biggest one yet! This patch is more than a few tweaks; it’s a full rework of the game’s core mechanics, designed to make every connection more intuitive, strategic, and satisfying.

Here’s what’s new in this update:

🔧 Core Gameplay Rework

 Pipes and grids now share a single resource pool, streamlining gameplay and making each move count.
 Cities still require water or electricity, but now you're managing one unified system.
🎯 Smarter Drawing

 You can only draw from stations, cities, or existing lines—no more guesswork.
 Rotators are gone! You now control city rotation naturally by drawing to or from a city.
🎥 New Camera Angle

 We've switched to a top-down view to reduce confusion and help you focus on solving each puzzle clearly.
📘 Fully Rewritten Tutorial

 Whether you're brand new or returning after a break, the new tutorial will guide you through the updated mechanics with ease.
🐛 Bug Fixes & Steam Leaderboards

 Various bug fixes across the board
 Steam leaderboards are finally fixed and functional 🎉

💛 We really appreciate all the feedback and patience whilst it has taken us a little while to get the patch out!

Whether you're jumping in for the first time or returning to build the ultimate city grid, we hope the new version of Tiny Connections feels better than ever. 

Let us know what you think - Happy connecting!
Short Circuit Team

notes.title: Patch 1.1.8
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes: We've addressed various bugs reported by the community to improve overall gameplay stability and performance.
 ]New Features: Players can now refund and delete water and power stations, providing greater flexibility in managing resources and infrastructure.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.6
notes.notes: Resolved an issue with keyboard input responsiveness during the tutorial phase. Players should now experience smoother and more consistent keyboard interactions.

notes.title: Whoopsie Update
